state.paragraph: On December 10, 2014, the ad hoc committee discussed the bids and the draft merger agreements with representatives of J.P. Morgan and Wachtell Lipton. The ad hoc committee was of the view that there could be no assurance that the board would approve either bid unless improved. In light of the closeness of the bids, recent positive developments identified at the board meeting on December 3, and the view shared by the ad hoc committee and J.P. Morgan that neither of the bids represented the bidders' respective best offers, the ad hoc committee instructed J.P. Morgan to inform each bidder that it would need to increase its bid, and to instruct the bidders to submit improved bids on December 12, 2014. On the evening of December 11, 2014, representatives of J.P. Morgan contacted Longview to inform Longview that the bidders have been asked to submit revised and improved bids, and to confirm that Longview continued to be interested and willing to participate in a potential transaction by rolling over a portion of its Company common stock, so long as Longview's participation was desired and approved by the ad hoc committee.

ledger_rows.Note: Set evening 12/10 for final bids, replacing the initial 12/05 plan; mark-ups and financing commitments requested in advance.
Final bids due; Buyer Group and Bidder 2 submitted; Bidder 3 no written offer.
Final bid letter with revised merger agreement; financing commitment documents provided 12/06; committee required improvement (#31).
Final bid letter with revised merger agreement; financing commitments not stated at this stage.
No written offer: verbal valuation not above ~$78 stock price; J.P. Morgan said unlikely to be competitive.
After 12/10 bids, required improvements by 12/12; J.P. Morgan informed bidders and contacted Longview 12/11.
Rollover: authorized to work with Longview after 12/09 introductory meetings; confidentiality agreement signed 12/12; voting-agreement form provided.
Declined: rollover would not affect its price; would consider only after execution of a merger agreement.
Improved bids due; Buyer Group and Bidder 2 submitted; both confirmed best and final.
Best and final; confirmed as such by conversation 12/12; revised draft and financing commitment documents submitted.
Oral interim offer; stated it was working to increase within hours; superseded same evening by $83.00 (#37).
Best and final; revised draft substantially executable; financing commitment documents; Longview participation helped achieve $83.00.
Selected the Buyer Group: board approved the $83.00 merger, subject to resolution of remaining open points; J.P. Morgan fairness opinion given.
Agreed $83.00 per share in cash; executed with Parent (Argos Holdings) and Merger Sub; voting and rollover agreements also executed.
Press release announced the transaction and $83.00 per share cash merger consideration.

deadline.instructions: `paragraph` reports that the target or its banker sets, changes or communicates a bid deadline, process letter or request for final offers. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
